text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with
Nice
Nature...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wait, someone's calling me.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Mom?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Sorry Trainer, I gotta take this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hi, Mom. You never call me like this.
What's up?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... I'm doing okay... I guess.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Really, I'm doing all right. Don't worry
about me,
Mom!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: What?! You're coming here?! When?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Aghhh, you always decide to visit so
suddenly. All
right... Call me later.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Sorry to keep you waiting.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's still a bit away, though.
Apparently, her
friend invited her on a
trip.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
They're planning to stay around this area
for
some time, so I'll go meet them when
they come.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Are you going to invite her to see you run?

text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, slow down there, will ya?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, it's not like I don't want her to,
but...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It's kind of embarrassing having my mom
watch
me. It feels like I'm in elementary
school...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: I'm sure she'd love to see you run!

text_block_list.text: Y-you think so?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: If I was your parent, I'd be over the moon!
If I was your parent I'd be over the moon!

text_block_list.text:
Surely her mother has some ulterior
motive for
coming here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tell Найс Нэйчер that, if I was her
mother, my
biggest motivation for going
on this trip would be
to see my
daughter's progress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're starting to sound like a
real parent
now.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
True, your jobs are pretty similar. But...
are you
sure?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, about what you said earlier. You
know...
That my mom would love to see
me run.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Isn't she your number one fan?

text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Even when I don't do
well, she's
still cheering for me...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I tell her that, as her trainer, I want her
mom to
know how amazing of a student
she is.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Student? Are you my teacher or
something?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're my trainer, so I guess you

technically are my teacher...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But do you think I'll be able to show her
anything
special?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
You've been hitting all your training goals, so
I'd say so!

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер seems relieved to hear my
positive
opinion of her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're so confident, you must
have some
tricks up your sleeve, right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: All right, you win! ...I'll invite my mom.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Well, I hope you're ready for show-and-tell then, Teach.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Hello, Mom? About your visit...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
If you don't have any plans... do you
want to
come visit Академия Тайсен?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
No, you don't have to come if you're
busy! I don't
know how fun it'll be just
watching me run.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Hm? Really? Okay... I'll tell my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She said she's coming. And that she's
excited.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Great. I can't be lame in front of her, so guess it's back to training for me...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She pretends to sound fed up, but I can
hear the
excitement in her voice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
